window.selectedBy: whichever of the two was addressed last

resets.name: GS Reset
resets.note: the Roland address the manual gives as the GS reset

resets.name: All Sound Off on channel 1
resets.note: A channel mode message rather than a reset, and addressed to one channel rather than to the unit. It is measured the same way because the question is the same one -- what does this put back -- and because the out-and-back an alias scan runs on cannot be run on a message that has one value and no opposite.
